title: SAFETY, ENGINEERING ETHICS AND PROFESSIONALISM
description: Introduction to engineering ethics and safety concepts. Topics include professional engineering responsibility, codes of ethics, ethical assessment, conflicts of interest, loyalty and dissent, life-long learning, hazard identification, risk and safety, and process safety management.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CBEE 212, 212H or 280.
A minimum grade of C is required in CBEE 212, CBEE 212H and CBEE 280.
meeting_html: TR 9am-9:50am in GILB 124 - Gilbert Hall 124 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
